text: {"lessons":["Short-term account swings—including the recent recovery—do not reveal what prices will do next, so I should not trade based on a price pattern.","I have made no trades, which may reflect patience but could also mean neglect; I should review my holdings periodically against my goals and make deliberate choices.","I should judge each stock by its current merits, not its purchase price or my reluctance to admit a mistake."]}
